questions.text: Which navigation pattern should be used on phone-sized screens?
options: Collapsible menu opened from the header
Keep the same header navigation, scaled down
questions.reason: The blueprint does not say how navigation should change on small screens, and the choice changes the layout of the app shell.

questions.text: What viewport widths should define phone, tablet and desktop layouts (for example, below 640px for phone)?
questions.reason: The breakpoints are not stated in the decision, feature or blueprint, and they are needed to test the acceptance criteria.

questions.text: Should this requirement include creating the app shell now if the repository does not yet have one?
questions.reason: The request says to create the app shell if it is missing. Whether one exists is a repository fact I did not assess here, so the owner should confirm the scope.

questions.text: Which browsers must be supported for the responsive layout?
options: Current versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari, on desktop and mobile
questions.reason: The support target affects which layout behaviours must be tested.
